meta.name: hyperframes-keyframes
meta.description: Use when a HyperFrames composition needs a punch-in, punch-out, zoom, reframe, Ken Burns treatment, camera move, visual match/whip handoff, or other seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes; also for GSAP, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, WAAPI, FLIP, paths, masks, SVG morph/draw, text trails, 3D depth, or `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics. Don't use for broad scene strategy, brand design, media sourcing, captions, or general video planning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给视频添加推拉缩放、运镜和转场关键帧动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想给视频片段添加电影感的推拉缩放和运镜动画
copy.tagline_en: Add punch-in, zoom, reframe, and camera-move keyframes to video compositions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you edit video and want cinematic push-in, zoom, and camera-move animation

howto.what: 装上后,助手会为 HyperFrames 画面编写 seek-safe 运动关键帧:缩放、平移、重构图、Ken Burns、遮罩、文字轨迹、3D 深度等,并按 GSAP 等规则创建、用 CLI 验证。
howto.when: 当 HyperFrames 画面需要推近拉远、缩放重构图、Ken Burns 运镜等主镜运动,或需要 GSAP、CSS keyframes、Anime.js 等关键帧动画时触发。

say.text: 给这段 HyperFrames 做推近效果。
say.note: 会创建缩放关键帧并跑验证。

say.text: 把这个镜头改成 Ken Burns 缓慢推镜。
say.note: 会生成平移加缩放的运镜关键帧。

say.text: 用 GSAP 给标题加文字淡入和位移。
say.note: 会按 GSAP 时间线规则注册并验证。

howto.what_en: After installation, the assistant authors seek-safe visual-motion keyframes for HyperFrames compositions: zoom, pan, reframe, Ken Burns, masks, text movement, 3D depth, etc., follows GSAP/CSS/Anime.js rules, and verifies with CLI proof.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a HyperFrames composition needs punch-in/out, zoom, reframe, Ken Burns, camera moves, whip handoffs, or other seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes, or GSAP, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, etc.

say_en.text: Add a punch-in to this HyperFrames clip.
say_en.note: Creates scale keyframes and runs verification.

say_en.text: Turn this shot into a slow Ken Burns push.
say_en.note: Generates pan and zoom movement keyframes.

say_en.text: Animate the title with GSAP fade and move.
say_en.note: Registers a GSAP timeline and verifies it.
